environment.description: Kubernetes cluster running migration-service as a Deployment with 3 replicas in namespace 'tools'. The /migrate endpoint is exposed via a ClusterIP Service. Other namespaces (including 'default' and 'attacker-workload') can freely reach the service. No Istio sidecar injection, no network policies. An attacker pod in namespace 'attacker-workload' can POST arbitrary SQL to /migrate endpoint, exploiting the race condition to apply conflicting migrations or inject malicious DDL.
